evidenceLabels.assessor-sale-association: Assessor sale association; deed image unreviewed

evidenceScope: Verified current addresses and historical company associations. Builder attribution for the current structures has not been confirmed.
geometryDescription: Approximate county parcel centers matched by parcel number, street address, and ZIP. These are not surveyed building locations.
heldRecoveryDescription: GIS-ZIP recovery candidates from the prior assessment remain outside this release pending validation.
researchWindowDescription: Recording-history research window, not continuous or complete historical coverage. County construction years are retained separately and can precede 1976.

reviewFlagDescriptions.chronology-review: The county construction year is at least three years after the earliest verified company recording. Structure identity and construction history need review; rebuilding is not established.
reviewFlagDescriptions.land-only-evidence: Supporting Assessor sales include residential land-only classifications and no residential improved-property classification. This does not establish who built the current structure.
reviewFlagDescriptions.legal-corroboration-missing: The complete plat, lot, and block combination was not independently corroborated. The verified association uses the Assessor recording-to-parcel crosswalk.
reviewFlagDescriptions.minor-chronology-gap: The county construction year is one or two years after the earliest verified company recording. This date difference alone does not establish rebuilding or a different builder.
reviewFlagDescriptions.multi-parcel-recording: The Assessor links a supporting recording to more than one parcel. Each public record remains a distinct verified PIN.
reviewFlagDescriptions.recording-crosswalk: The Assessor recording-to-parcel crosswalk differs from the recorder index PIN. The verified address uses the Assessor crosswalk.
reviewFlagDescriptions.assessor-sale-association: The Assessor directly associates this PIN with a sale by a reviewed company name. The deed image and original builder have not been independently confirmed.
